paper_title: 1.4 Million Open-Source Distilled Reasoning Dataset to Empower Large   Language Model Training
caption: Distribution of reference answers and test cases in the dataset. Among the entries, 38.9% have reference answers, 21.9% include test cases, and 39.2% have neither reference answers nor test cases.

annotations.annotation: The pie chart represents the distribution of categories concerning reference answers and test cases. It includes three slices with distinct colors: "Null" which is colored pink and represents 39.2%, "Have reference answer" in blue with 38.9%, and "Have test case" in green comprising 21.9% of the chart. The chart includes a legend located at the top left corner, which details each category with corresponding colors and numerical values. The percentage for each category is also labeled outside the respective slices. The slices are not visually emphasized through any methods such as explosion or offsetting, and they do not appear to be ordered in a particular sequence beyond their proportions.
